map.算例：牵引力 300 kN、运行速度 80 km/h: Worked example: tractive effort 300 kN, running speed 80 km/h
map.牵引功率 = 300 × 80 ÷ 3.6 = 6666.67 kW；每 kN: Tractive power = 300 × 80 ÷ 3.6 = 6666.67 kW; each kN of tractive effort needs 80 ÷ 3.6 = 22.22 kW/kN; tractive effort per unit speed = 300 ÷ 80 = 3.750 kN per km/h; equivalent per km/h = 300 × 3.6 ÷ 80 = 13.5000 kN; back-calculating with a transmission efficiency of 0.85 gives a rated diesel engine power = 6666.67 ÷ 0.85 = 7843.14 kW.
map.1 kN × 1 km/h = 1000 N × 0.2778 m/s = 27: Because 1 kN × 1 km/h = 1000 N × 0.2778 m/s = 277.8 W, so P (kW) = F (kN) × v (km/h) ÷ 3.6. The coefficient is tied to the unit system; switching to tf or m/s requires a new conversion.
map.0.85 的传动效率指什么？: What does the transmission efficiency of 0.85 mean?
map.指从柴油机到轮周（主发电机、牵引电机、齿轮箱等）的综合传动效率，电传动内燃机车通: It is the overall transmission efficiency from the diesel engine to the wheel rim, covering the main generator, traction motors and gearbox; diesel-electric locomotives are usually 0.82-0.88, while hydraulic transmission types are slightly lower. Take the value from the actual curve of the locomotive type.
